extraction_text: 5.1 The Employer has the exclusive right to operate and manage the business; to determine the methods and means of production; to introduce new and improved processes, equipment and machinery; to sell, lease and dispose of any portion or all of the business; to establish the hours of work and the days and weeks of operations; to authorize and assign overtime; to determine the number of employees, to hire, promote, direct assign and layoff the work force; and to discipline and discharge employees for just cause, provided that anymore specific provisions of this agreement shall prevail and that the exercise of such rights shall not be used to discriminate against any member of the Union because of his/her union activities
